Mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoNordestino2025/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Por favor leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição, bem como as [Orientações Adicionais](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/guidelines.html). Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a CMCE, a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- 🇬🇧 Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance. More information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoNordestino2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full) before the competition. By registering, you authorize CMCE, ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.
